# Required status checks for `main` — config as code.
#
# Branch protection is configured in GitHub Settings, which means the list of
# required checks lived only in prose and drifted: jobs were added to CI that
# nobody ever added to the list, so a PR could merge with them red.
#
# This file is the source of truth. `scripts/check_required_checks.py` (run by
# `make lint`, so by CI) fails if any name here is not a real job that runs on
# pull_request, and fails if any PR check name is ambiguous across workflows —
# GitHub matches required checks BY NAME, so a duplicated name cannot be
# required unambiguously.
#
# To apply this list to branch protection (needs admin):
#
#   python3 scripts/check_required_checks.py --print-api
#
# One check name per line. Blank lines and #-comments ignored.

# --- the gates that decide whether a commit is releasable -------------------
lint
mutation
install-smoke
patch-coverage

# Every matrix leg of ci.yml's `tests` job. They are listed individually
# because GitHub requires the expanded matrix name, not the job id.
tests (ubuntu-latest, 3.9)
tests (ubuntu-latest, 3.12)
tests (ubuntu-latest, 3.14)
tests (macos-latest, 3.9)
tests (macos-latest, 3.12)
tests (macos-latest, 3.14)
tests (windows-latest, 3.9)
tests (windows-latest, 3.12)
tests (windows-latest, 3.14)

# --- security / supply chain ------------------------------------------------
codeql-analyze
pip-audit
metadata
scan-pr / osv-scan

# --- docs + site ------------------------------------------------------------
validate
markdown-lint
